bundle.shortDescription: Save public media with local-first extractors and verified fallbacks.
bundle.longDescription: MediaFilez Desktop is a free, open-source downloader for public video, images, galleries, and audio. It manages its local extraction tools and can use user-approved fallbacks when a site needs another method.
